role: New actual framework evidence; targeted source decisions pending

rows.authorProposedBridge: Upper whole information competence: KMK AHR K1/K2/K8/K12, read at physical17–18, connected to current SL GK/LK physical3–4. Complex forms, selection, interpretation, conclusions, sources and quotation marking are explicit standard components; common levels are defined at physical14.
rows.mediaAdditionalBoundedSupport: Actual 2019 physical12 sections2.1/2.2 support independent multi-source research and differentiated preparation; physical16 section4.3 and physical17 section4.4 support attribution and quotation rules. Mirror/current-version and non-binding grade progression limits remain.
rows.wholeObligationLimit: Candidate whole-role sufficiency is an interpretation requiring both independent source reviewers. It does not establish completion by the end of EP, actual independent learner performance, every original source duty, or normal Atlas adoption.

wholeCurrentInactiveGoal.title: Komplexe chemische Quellen selbstständig erschließen
wholeCurrentInactiveGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann zu chemischen oder pharmazeutischen Fragen selbstständig in analogen und digitalen Medien recherchieren, relevante Informationen und Daten auch aus komplexen Darstellungen auswählen, strukturieren und interpretieren, daraus fachliche Schlussfolgerungen ableiten sowie Quellen belegen und Zitate kennzeichnen.
wholeCurrentInactiveGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can independently research chemical or pharmaceutical questions in analogue and digital media, select, structure, and interpret relevant information and data from complex representations, derive scientific conclusions, cite sources, and mark quotations.

rows.authorProposedBridge: Upper whole source criticism: KMK AHR K3/K4/K12 and B1–B4, actual physical18–19, address comparison, trust/origin/quality, authorship, scientific correctness, suitability/limits and author intention. Current SL GK/LK physical3–4 gives the subject-framework connection. This uses actual original statements beyond a plastics significance discussion.
rows.mediaAdditionalBoundedSupport: Actual 2019 physical13 section2.3 treats comparing reports and stakeholder intention. Physical16 source attribution supports origin. No general trust/validity clearance is inferred from the media table alone.
rows.wholeObligationLimit: Matching all canonical validity and relevance wording is an explicit author interpretation, not a literal single standards bullet. The two source reviewers must decide it independently; all earlier whole-duty/operator limits remain.

wholeCurrentInactiveGoal.title: Chemische Quellen und Darstellungen kritisch prüfen
wholeCurrentInactiveGoal.titleEn: Critically assess chemistry sources and representations
wholeCurrentInactiveGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann analoge und digitale Quellen oder Darstellungsformen zu chemischen Sachverhalten hinsichtlich ihrer Aussagen, fachlichen Relevanz, Vertrauenswürdigkeit, Urheberschaft und Intention vergleichen und ihre Eignung und Validität für eine konkrete Frage begründet beurteilen.
wholeCurrentInactiveGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can compare analogue and digital sources or representations of chemical issues in terms of their claims, scientific relevance, trustworthiness, authorship, and intention, and justify their suitability and validity for a specific question.

rows.authorProposedBridge: Lower question/hypothesis component: KMK2024 MSA physical11 E1.1 explicitly includes developing both questions and hypotheses; E1.2 requires checking them. Historical2004 physical13 E1/E2 and physical10 background are comparison evidence only.
rows.wholeObligationLimit: Self-justification and expected supporting/counter findings are not asserted as literal E1.1 statements. The exact SL grade/scope/version bridge is unresolved. Preserve the whole lower-target HOLD until genuinely reviewed; do not apply upper AHR to SekI.

wholeCurrentInactiveGoal.title: Chemische Alltagsfragen und prüfbare Hypothesen formulieren
wholeCurrentInactiveGoal.titleEn: Formulate everyday chemical questions and testable hypotheses
wholeCurrentInactiveGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann zu einem beobachtbaren Alltags- oder Technikphänomen eine chemisch untersuchbare Frage und eine durch Beobachtungen prüfbare Hypothese selbst formulieren, die Hypothese begründen und angeben, welcher erwartbare Befund dafür oder dagegen spräche.
wholeCurrentInactiveGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can independently formulate a chemically investigable question and an observation-testable hypothesis about an observable everyday or technological phenomenon, justify the hypothesis and specify an expected finding that would support or contradict it.
